status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.
scope: Persist active drill state until the user explicitly resets it, and apply the supplied edited JSON to the matching FTO algorithm source files.
assumptions: Closing the drill is not an explicit reset; clearing results or starting a new drill is.
Only scramble, algorithms, and recognition values from the supplied edits may overwrite matching cases.

tasks.title: Inspect drill lifecycle and supplied edit payload
tasks.summary: Identify state that is reset on close or dataset changes and validate the datasets in the supplied payload.
verify: List target dataset keys and edited case counts.

tasks.title: Persist drill state until explicit reset
allowed_fields: drill state lifecycle and local storage helpers
protected_fields: case data and non-drill UI state
tasks.summary: Save and restore drill progress, selected source, settings, and records without treating close or dataset navigation as a reset.
verify: Confirm close does not clear persistent drill data.
Confirm explicit clear/start semantics reset the appropriate data.

tasks.title: Apply supplied case edits to algorithm JSON
tasks.summary: Match records by dataset and case id, preserving structural metadata.
verify: Confirm all 86 supplied edits matched exactly once.

tasks.title: Regenerate application data and verify outputs
tasks.summary: Rebuild bundled application data after source JSON changes and verify the edited values are present.
verify: Confirm generated data includes representative edited values.
